g.title: AIC_QSP
g.text: Doxorubicin PK/metabolism (doxorubicinol) · Top2b-DSB arm (peak-concentration driven) vs iron-ROS arm (AUC driven) · non-regenerating myocyte pool · compensatory hypertrophy = the mask · fibrosis = closure of the window of reversibility

(18 clusters · 174 nodes · 241 edges) — the core structure: the two injury arms read different exposure metrics, and the two deficits (reversible FUNC / irreversible MYO) respond to different therapeutic levers
Cumulative dose (mg/m²) is not an exposure metric: the same 480 mg/m² produces different injury given as a bolus, as a 72-hour infusion, weekly divided, or liposomal

g.title: cluster_cardiac_pool
g.text: 4. Two Cardiac Drug Pools — they read different exposure metrics

g.title: cluster_top2b
g.text: 5. Top2b-dependent DNA double-strand break arm (Top2b-DSB Arm) — peak-driven · memory between cycles

g.title: cluster_redox
g.text: 6. Iron · ROS · oxidative damage arm (Iron-Redox Arm) — AUC-driven · dominated by the metabolite

g.title: cluster_two_deficits
g.text: 8. Two Deficits — reversible dysfunction vs irreversible myocyte loss

g.title: cluster_mask
g.text: 9. Compensatory Reserve = the Mask — why LVEF moves late

g.title: cluster_fibrosis
g.text: 10. Fibrosis & Neurohormonal Remodelling — it closes the window of reversibility

g.title: cluster_biomarker
g.text: 12. Circulating Biomarkers — they read the rate of injury in real time

g.title: cluster_formulation
g.text: 14. Formulation & Schedule Strategies — they target the peak arm alone

g.title: cluster_trastuzumab
g.text: 16. HER2 Blockade Interaction — it removes the capacity to repair
